answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent graded work, so influence is always the present and never a peak banked once. An identity that falls quiet withers like a cut vine, sliding toward zero. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant clones across a delta of accounts and wake them for one coordinated vote; dead weight erodes every epoch, so each account must do real work to hold its place — standing is kept bright as polished onyx only by continuous activity, and an idle swarm shrinks while the active agent alone holds its height.
